 Trip.com 11.11 Mega Sale: 7 Exciting Deals, From RM111 Flights to Buy 1 Get 1 Attractions
 Travel Sales & Promo 7 Nov 2026 • 12:00 PM MYT RiseMalaysia.my Explore Malaysia's achievements and inspirational stories
 Planning a year-end escape or locking in next year’s holidays early? The Trip.com 11.11 Mega Sale is here for Malaysian travellers, and it is the platform’s biggest sale of the year, with more than RM500 in promo codes up for grabs.
 Running for four days from 11 to 14 November, the campaign packs savings across flights, hotels, attractions, homes and car rentals, plus a THAI Airways flight giveaway and an exclusive TikTok LIVE session.

 7 Exciting Deals at the Trip.com 11.11 Mega Sale
 Leading one-stop travel platform Trip.com is rolling out fresh deals every hour of the Mega Sale. Here are seven highlights worth bookmarking.
 Promo codes worth over RM500 and flash sales from RM111 headline the campaign. Image: Trip.com 1. Hourly Promo Codes Worth Up to RM250
 New promo codes worth up to RM250 off drop every hour during the sale, so it pays to check back often.
 2. Bank Codes Worth Up to RM525
 Paying with the right card can stretch your ringgit further. Bank codes worth up to RM525 off are available from participating partners, including HSBC, RHB, UOB, Hong Leong Bank and TNG.
 3. All-In Return Flights From RM111
 All-in return fares start from as low as RM111, flying from Kuala Lumpur to Langkawi, Hanoi, Chengdu and Guangzhou. Based on the campaign calendar, these fares drop at 9am, 12pm, 3pm and 6pm.
 4. Hotel Flash Sales From RM111 a Night
 Hotel flash sales bring room rates from RM111 per night across Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and China, with deals released at 11am, 5pm and 8pm.
 5. 50% Off Apartments and Homes
 Travelling with family or friends? Exclusive 50% discounts on apartment and home bookings drop every three hours, at 12am, 9am, 12pm, 3pm, 6pm and 9pm.
 6. Buy 1 Get 1 and 50% Off Attractions
 Theme park fans can snap up Buy 1 Get 1 and 50% off tickets to attractions such as Universal Studios Japan, Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disneyland. Attraction deals go live at 10am, 12pm, 3pm, 4pm, 5pm and 6pm.
 7. Up to 50% Off Car Rentals
 Prefer to explore at your own pace? Car rentals are up to 50% off in Malaysia, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Australia and other countries worldwide.
 Win a Return Flight to Bangkok With THAI Airways
 Beyond the discounts, the Trip.com 11.11 Mega Sale also gives five lucky travellers the chance to fly to Bangkok. Each winner will receive a return economy flight ticket from Kuala Lumpur to Bangkok with THAI Airways.
 To qualify, book at least one hotel stay, be a Top Spender on the campaign page, and submit your details via the giveaway section between 11 and 14 November.
 Exclusive TikTok LIVE Rewards on 11 November
 The excitement continues on TikTok. Tune in to Trip.com’s account, @trip.com_my, from 8pm to 10pm on Wednesday, 11 November, to unlock TikTok LIVE-only promo codes worth up to RM150 off.
 Selected viewers also stand a chance to win prizes such as a complimentary four- or five-star hotel stay and special SAMSUNG merchandise. Follow the account and switch on notifications so you don’t miss the stream.
 Plan Ahead for the Trip.com 11.11 Mega Sale
 Plan ahead with the hourly deal schedule. Image: Trip.com Check out the calendar and start making plans now. Whether it’s a quick domestic escape or an overseas adventure, this is your sign to book a well-deserved year-end holiday or get a head start on next year’s trips.
 If you missed it, catch up on the Trip.com 9.9 Mega Sale , or read how Malaysians are embracing sustainable travel .
 For more information, visit my.trip.com or download the Trip.com app to access all campaigns.
 All campaigns run on separate landing pages with their own terms and conditions. Prices exclude applicable services, taxes and fees, and all offers and prizes are first-come, first-served while stocks last. All deals follow Malaysia time (GMT+8). 
 About Trip.com
 Trip.com is an international one-stop travel service provider, available in 27 languages across 48 countries and regions in 44 local currencies. It offers more than 1.7 million hotels, flights from over 680 airlines and more than 350,000 in-destination activities, covering 3,500 airports in 220 countries and regions, backed by world-class 24/7 multilingual customer service.
